title: Sheaf of relative Kahler differentials
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. The sheaf $\Omega^1_{X/S}$ of relative Kähler differentials is the $\mathcal O_X$-module whose restriction to every affine $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ mapping into an affine $V=\operatorname{Spec}R$ is the sheaf associated to $\Omega_{A/R}$ [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials], with the universal derivations compatible under restriction.
